The words विन्दु and इच्छु are irregularly formed by the addition of the affix उ , in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.'.

Terms: Irregular उ
The affix डुवन् (-/- -अक) comes in the senses taught up to

after the words विंशति and त्रिंशत् , when it does not denote a Name: the ति and अत् of the base being dropped before this affix.

Terms:
The affix ख (ईन) comes in the आर्हीय senses

-63 after the word विंशतिक , when preceded by the word अध्यर्द्ध or a Numeral, occasioning a द्विगु।

Terms:

The affixes ना and नाञ् comes in the sense of 'not being together' after the words 1. वि and 2. नञ् respectively.

Terms: ना and नाञ्

After the words विंशति etc. तमट् (तम feminine in ङीप्) is optionally the augment of डट्।

Terms: डट् and (तमट्)

The affixes विन् and मत् are लुक् elided when इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow.

Terms: इष्ठन् and इयसुन्

The affix ठक् comes without changing the sense after the word विनय etc.

Terms: ठक्
